lead: Dilip Kumar was a film actor, born on 11 December 1922 in Peshawar.
He died on 7 July 2021 in P. D. Hinduja National Hospital & Medical Research Centre, Mumbai at the age of 98.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of Dilip Kumar: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Dilip Kumar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Dilip Kumar was born on 11 December 1922 in Peshawar, and holds citizenship of British Raj and India. He was given the name Mohammed Yusuf Khan at birth and is publicly known as Dilip Kumar.
He is a sibling of Nasir Khan.
He is recorded as speaking Urdu, Pashto, Hindko and Punjabi.

sections.heading: Dilip Kumar — Career and Professional Work
paras: Dilip Kumar works primarily as a film actor, film director, film producer and politician.
He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (2000–2006). He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
